name: Multiply All Others
summary: For each output slot i, multiply together every element except nums[i]. Uses no division and O(n^2) time — the baseline the prefix/suffix trick optimises to O(n).
visualizationIntent: init: show the input array and an empty result. outer-loop: the i cursor picks an output slot; that cell dims to show it is skipped. inner-loop: the j cursor sweeps every other element, multiplying them into a running product. update: write the product into the result slot. return: the completed products array.

lineExplanations.5: Choose the output slot i to compute.
lineExplanations.7: Sweep every index to consider as a factor.
lineExplanations.8: Skip the element at i itself.
lineExplanations.9: Multiply every other element into the running product.
lineExplanations.10: Store the product for output slot i.

syntaxExplanations.1: class Solution: defines the class wrapper expected by the platform.
syntaxExplanations.2: def productExceptSelf(self, nums): receives the input array.
syntaxExplanations.4: result = [] creates the empty output list.
syntaxExplanations.5: for i in range(n): picks each output slot.
syntaxExplanations.6: prod = 1 starts the running product at the multiplicative identity.
syntaxExplanations.7: for j in range(n): visits every element as a potential factor.
syntaxExplanations.8: if j != i: skips the slot's own element.
syntaxExplanations.9: prod = prod * nums[j] multiplies in every other element.
syntaxExplanations.10: result.append(prod) records the product for slot i.
syntaxExplanations.11: return result hands back all products.
